Other 135 interfaces have independent passing checks at both widths; mobile renderer baselines were not persisted for cross-run text comparison.

Original full run stopped on a harness shape/parity issue: generic LaunchTool uses Result; Volume/Slope source panes were added during the run. Both selector handling and final-source candidate rechecks are complete.

Scenario details are programmatically expanded; actual capture/export/recover buttons and text input exercise the real UI. No file chooser, saved-history database or authentication acceptance is claimed.

Final Stats4 source changed to pure view plus sibling account workflow composition after the original run. Only these nine affected interfaces were rerun at both widths; 150 unaffected interfaces retained their previous accepted evidence. Stats4 final checks observe real four snapshot controls, invalid disabling/recovery, full renderer parity, labels, keyboard, and overflow. No additional history or scenario eligibility is claimed.

Final graph source restored normalized SVG axis guides with no model/input/output/steps change. Only graphing-calculator and function-plotter-2d were rerun at both widths, including full-renderer parity, required-input recovery, genuine account export/scenario recovery and reciprocal sampled-gap/no-bridge assertions. Evidence for the other 157 interfaces is retained.
